criteria.name: Active Listening & Understanding
criteria.question: Did the AGENT acknowledge, paraphrase, or confirm the customer's need or concern before responding, rather than talking past them? Judge only the agent.

criteria.name: Clarity of Communication
criteria.question: Were the AGENT's explanations clear, specific, and free of confusing jargon? Cite the clearest agent line, or if communication was poor, the most confusing one.

criteria.name: Empathy & Professional Tone
criteria.question: Was the AGENT courteous, patient, and empathetic throughout the call? Cite a representative agent line.
